text:
Here's the summary, drawn directly from `packages/core/src/agent.ts` — the `runReActLoop()` method (line 3281) and its orchestration across the full `AgentHarness` class.

---

## The ReAct Loop — `runReActLoop()` at `agent.ts:3281`

**1. Pre-flight guards, then streaming LLM call with adaptive routing and provider resilience.**

Each round begins with abort-signal checks, round-cap enforcement (`maxToolRoundsPerTurn`), contract-budget exhaustion, and periodic anti-drift scoring (every 4 rounds, drift ≥ 0.55 triggers replan). Yield snapshots are written for crash recovery. Context-pressure alerts fire at 60% / 85% utilization with proactive compression at 65%+. Memory is primed via auto-recall (with a semantic dream gate — BM25 scoring against the notes index, skipping recall if the score is below threshold, plus contradiction detection against recent tool output). The harness then builds messages and makes a streaming LLM call (`this.client.chat.completions.create` at line 5166) through a retry wrapper with provider circuit-breaking, prompt-cache breakpoints, and PASTE-enabled speculative dispatch (safe tool calls like file writes launch before the stream finishes).

**2. Tool dispatch with DAG topological ordering, safety gating, dedup, and loop detection.**

Tool calls accumulated from the stream are de-duplicated (identical `(name, args)` pairs), checked against a per-send banlist for 3×-failure loop breaks, and dispatched. `dispatch_graph` calls run first to populate the DAG, then remaining calls are executed in topological batches so dependencies resolve before dependents. Per-call results flow through output distillation (fast-model summarization for large tool outputs), read-file anti-loop nudges (at 2× and 4× re-reads of the same file), `think()`/`breakdown()` family pre-activation, and vault/web-search activity tracking. Duplicate cross-round calls are signaled so the model reuses `query_tool_outputs` instead of re-running identical work.

**3. Recursive re-entry or finalization with critic gates.**

If tool calls were dispatched (or if length-resume / no-finish-reason continuations are needed), the loop recurses: `await this.runReActLoop(round + 1)`. When the model produces text-only output, the harness runs finalization checks — a verify-result critic, synthesis-completeness checks for research turns, deck-pipeline enforcement (pptx path, not markdown-only), vision-completion guards for image-centric asks, and a `turn_end` emit with recipe recording / episodic trajectory logging. Pseudo-tool-markup recovery (stalled JSON in text instead of real tool calls) gets one retry with a correction message.
